notes.title: 🏡 Home Path is going to be Free to Play!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]I’m happy to announce that [b]Home Path[/b] is now [b]Free to Play[/b]![/p][p]This game was one of my very first projects developed under [b]LilithGuild[/b], and while it’s a small and simple experience, it’s close to my heart. I’m making it free so anyone can try it out and enjoy it without any cost.[/p][p]Thank you for your support throughout my development journey — and feel free to share the game with your friends if you’d like to![/p][p]– Lino[/p]

notes.title: Controller Partial Support
notes.notes:
Now you can play Home Path with a Controller (Partially).
[list]
[*] Use a controller to play Home Path. Only works for the main Gameplay.
[/list]
